description: This file defines a React functional component 'Modal', which renders a modal dialog box with optional title, footer, and content children. It manages visibility via the 'open' prop and handles close events with 'onClose'. It also imports a Button component for a close button.

methods.name: Modal
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a modal dialog box with customizable title, footer, and content. It handles display based on the 'open' prop and calls 'onClose' when the background overlay or close button is clicked.
